asset_id.description: Stable, machine-safe. Derived from the relative path, never the absolute path.
asset_id.title: Asset Id

relative_path.description: POSIX path relative to case root (or 'external:<n>' for --reference inputs).
relative_path.title: Relative Path

detected_format.description: What the content is, independent of the name.

Execution.description: Execution-specific metadata. Excluded from the semantic digest.
Execution.title: Execution

records_sampled.description: Leading records parsed for structure only; sequences/qualities are never stored.
records_sampled.title: Records Sampled

end_of_file_verified.description: BGZF EOF marker check; None for plain gzip (not verifiable without full decompression).
end_of_file_verified.title: End Of File Verified

input_fingerprint.description: sha256 over sorted asset content digests — changes iff biological/technical content changes.
input_fingerprint.title: Input Fingerprint

inventory_fingerprint.description: sha256 over sorted (relative_path, digest) — also changes on renames/moves.
inventory_fingerprint.title: Inventory Fingerprint

markers.description: e.g. decoy_contigs, alt_contigs, hla_contigs, ebv_contig, hg19_style_chrM
markers.title: Markers

claim_conflict.description: Header text claims a build other than the one contig lengths establish.
claim_conflict.title: Claim Conflict

message.description: Operator-facing description. Must never contain genomic payload or raw sample labels.
message.title: Message

PrimaryInputs.description: Where downstream stages should look — so nobody re-derives it from filenames.

primary_variant_asset_id.description: Set only when unambiguous (exactly one) or explicitly configured.
primary_variant_asset_id.title: Primary Variant Asset Id

PrimaryInputs.title: PrimaryInputs

asserted_role.description: Roles such as proband/mother/father are never inferred; see pedigree.relationships for explicit assertions.
asserted_role.title: Asserted Role

has_records.description: Whether at least one record parsed. Record content is never stored.
has_records.title: Has Records

reference_claim.description: Raw ##reference value (may be a local path).
reference_claim.title: Reference Claim

semantic_digest.description: sha256 of this manifest excluding `execution` and this field.
semantic_digest.title: Semantic Digest

title: CaseManifest
description: CaseManifest v1.0.0 — output of the case_intake stage. Properties carrying `restricted: true` are populated only in the private manifest.
